method: computed by the authors from facet count: eye field taken as a hemisphere (41,253 deg squared) divided by the number of facets, facets outlined and counted in ImageJ

source.authors: Clifton GT, Holway D, Gravish N
source.title: Vision does not impact walking performance in Argentine ants

where: Results, Argentine ant eye anatomy, p. 5
quote: We measured eye area to be 0.026mm2 with an interommatidial angle of 15.3 deg.
note: The angle is an estimate from facet count, not an optical measurement; the paper cites Wild 2004 for 80 to 100 ommatidia per eye. The paper states that temporal acuity has not been measured in ants.
